scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Hello? I'm Artisan Tene, the most respectful blacksmith of them all.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: How may I help you?
Which blacksmith?
I want to add option.
I want to remove option.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Oh! Sorry, I didn't introduce myself.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: I can add or remove options from some weapons and armor at a small price.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Oh! Do you want to know the list of weapons and armor I work on?
Take a look at the weapon list.
Take a look at the armor list.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Are you interested in the weapon list?

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text:
The weapons I work on are 
^ff0000Raksasa Dagger [1]^000000
^ff0000Mikatsuki[1]^000000
^ff0000Huuma Swirling Petal [2]^000000
^ff0000Huuma Fluttering Snow^000000
^ff0000Huuma Thunderstorm^000000

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Are you interested in the armor list?

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text:
The armor I work on is
^ff0000Wolf Armguard [1]^000000
^ff0000Crescent Armguard [1]^000000
^ff0000Ninja Scale Armor [1]^000000
^ff0000Tenebris Latitantes [1]^000000
^ff0000Special Ninja Suit [1]^000000

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: This is it. I'm still in practice to learn and handle more battlegear.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: If you'd like, I can add options to your 4th and 3rd Slots at a small cost.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text:
Oh! You need to add an option.
I use the method of adding options to your 4th and 3rd slots of battlegear equipped.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Since I use a stable and unique way of adding options, there are no risks of ^ff0000'Reset Refine'^000000 or ^ff0000'Losing Cards'^000000 equipped.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: But since the costs of materials are high, I only ask for a ^5565AA small cost^000000 for my services with the exception of the material expenses.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Ha ha. I must have talked too much. Which class of equipment do you want to add an option to?
Weapon...
Armor...

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: So you want to add an option to your weapon. That will be ^ff0000100,000 Zeny for a 1 time service.^000000

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: ^FF0000Ah! I can add an additional option if you equip a one-handed weapon on your right hand because it is easier for me to work on.^000000

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Which weapon do you want to add an option to?
Later...
Raksasa Dagger [1]
Mikatsuki [1]
Huuma Swirling Petal [2]
Huuma Fluttering Snow
Huuma Thunderstorm

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Changed your mind? Very well. Hope to see you later.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: So you want to add an option to your armor. That will be ^ff0000100,000 Zeny for a 1 time service.^000000

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Which armor do you want to add an option to?
Later...
Wolf Armguard [1]
Crescent Armguard [1]
Ninja Scale Armor [1]
Tenebris Latitantes [1]
Special Ninja Suit [1]

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Changed your mind? Very well. Hope to see you later.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: You want to remove an option from your item. You didn't like the option?

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Sorry but I'm not experienced enough. You've paid me for nothing.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: ^ff0000Removing an option will be 100,000 Zeny.^000000 Which option from the list of items do you want to remove?
Later...
Raksasa Dagger [1]
Mikatsuki [1]

Huuma Fluttering Snow
Huuma Thunderstorm

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Removing options is expensive, isn't it? Sorry. I will work harder in developing my skills and bring down costs as well.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: You want to reset ^44B7BC{0}^000000?

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: The cost is the same but I do provide a service to remove only the option on the 3rd slot and leave the 4th slot as is. Are you interested?
Reset only the 3rd Slot.
Reset all.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Very well. I will reset only your 3rd slot.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Very well. I will reset all slots.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: You will have to equip all items before ^44B7BC{0}^000000.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: I'm sorry, but you don't have enough Zeny!

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: Our charge is very low, so please bear with me.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: I don't think this is the equipment you requested.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: I cannot work on equipment other than those from my list.

scripts.speaker: Artisan Tene
scripts.text: The third slot is is not enchanted. Please check again.

scripts.text: If you are not satisfied with the enchantments, I suggest that you initialize.
